snippet.title: Warhounds - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Don't miss the Gameplay Trailer for Warhounds, a turn-based tactical strategy game developed by Brightika. Players will command an elite mercenary outfit to take on intense missions in a near-future Africa. Make key decisions in terms of positioning, cover, and more to progress through the full narrative campaign. Warhounds is coming soon to PC. 

Wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3929470/Warhounds/

#IGN #Gaming
